Me and DH have done this the last few years, a joint present then a few other ones (Rock band one year, Xbox another year)

Well, I bought a few other ones for him and a few for myself cos I told him to NOT buy me anything! All presents signed from Santa 

Then he produced a bag of presents he had bought for me, so I ended up with loads :rotfl:
